FROM NOTES TO NEXT TAKE

Three small steps.
You’ve got this.

  1. 01

    Bring your words.

    Paste a script or import a text or Markdown file. Add headings to turn sections into cues.

  2. 02

    Find your spot.

    Dock near your camera or float the panel wherever feels natural. Set your text size, colour and pace.

  3. 03

    Make it sound like you.

    Press play, take a breath and say what you came to say. Your camera stays with your meeting or recording app.

GOOD QUESTIONS

A few things
before your first take.

Does Telex need my microphone or camera?+

No-microphone scrolling needs neither. Voice-level pacing uses your microphone. Optional script-word transcription additionally needs Apple Speech authorization and a supported on-device language. Telex does not activate your camera for prompting.

Will Telex show up in a screen share?+

It may. Stealth is best effort and marked Limited on macOS 15 or later. Other apps can capture the panel during whole-display sharing. Share an individual application window, use a second display, or hide Telex. Built-in screen recording uses an exclusion filter; verify a test recording before relying on it.

Can I use Telex without an internet connection?+

Yes. Your scripts are stored locally, and continuous scrolling works offline. Optional word following depends on available on-device Apple speech assets and permissions.

What Mac does it run on?+

The current build targets macOS 14 or later and includes both Apple silicon and Intel binaries. The download is a compressed 2.77 MB disk image.

Is this a public release?+

This download is a development build. It is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. macOS may block opening it. Recording, third-party sharing, accessibility and performance validation are still in progress.
